name: Garlic Barrier
desc: A pungent, consecrated paste of wild garlic and mountain ash covers your collar and wrists.  The acrid odor causes undead and night creatures to hesitate and falter when closing in.
apply_message: You rub the pungent garlic balm across your collar and wrists.  An astringent, warding aroma envelops you.
decay_messages: The pungent scent of garlic balm fades from your clothes.

name: Hunter's Steadfast Courage
desc: Your nerves are steeled by Father Michael's consecrated courage draught.  Supernatural dread and psychic chill cannot shake your focus.
apply_message: A bitter, warming fire courses through your chest.  Your hands steady and supernatural fear vanishes.
decay_messages: The calming heat of the courage draught gradually recedes.

name: Aura of Sanctuary
desc: You stand under the spiritual protection of consecrated geometry and ancient sacraments.  Your mind is guarded against unnatural corruption and psychic dread.
apply_message: A peaceful, protective warmth hums around your spirit.
decay_messages: The spiritual presence of the sanctuary ward fades away.

name: Wood in Flesh
desc: Splinters and fragments of wooden weapons are embedded deeply in flesh.  The organic wood acts as a cellular poison to unholy biology, severely stalling regeneration, causing intense searing pain, and slowing movement.
apply_message: Jagged wood splinters bite into cold unliving flesh, searing like acid and stalling regeneration!
decay_messages: The burning wooden splinters are finally expelled from the wounds.

name: Silver Burns
desc: Pure silver has scorched the lupine flesh, searing like holy fire through beastly tissue.  The metal suppresses rapid cellular regeneration, causing agonizing pain and burning.
apply_message: Searing silver burns violently into the werewolf's flesh, scorching unholy blood and halting regeneration!
decay_messages: The silver burns slowly begin to cauterize and cool.
